item.title: Identifying and Correcting Servo Errors in a Robot Cat
item.description: Tools, Design, and Process When a robot cat doesn’t move like a real cat, it’s a problem. To make his robot move with cat-like grace, Jose identified the problem (unstable servo voltage), and designed a solution, made with a Hall effect current sensor, a linear regulator, and a hand-built PCB.
